diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2.3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Renesas HS300x datasheet (April 9, 2021), page 1 Physical Characteristics: "Supply voltage: 2.3V to 5.5V" ("Extended supply voltage: 1.8V (-20°C to +125°C)"); Tables 4 and 5 are specified at "VDD = 2.3V to 5.5V". In Table 3 (Operating Conditions) the 3.3 V figure for Operating Supply Voltage sits in the Typical column (Minimum cell blank, Maximum 5.5 V), so the second reading mistook the typical value for the minimum. The Temp&Hum 18 Click schematic (v100) has no regulator: VCC from the VCC SEL jumper (3V3 or 5V pin) goes straight to HS3003 VDD, so the chip's 2.3 V minimum applies at the 3V3 pin.
